exercises.name: Supported sit-to-stand
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for supported sit-to-stand.
cues: Use your hands lightly on a stable chair as you stand.
Press through your whole foot and stand tall.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Builds confidence with the squat pattern using extra support.

exercises.name: Chair squat
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for chair squat.
cues: Reach your hips back toward a stable chair.
Keep your knees tracking in the same direction as your toes.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Practises controlled sitting and standing strength.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat to chair target
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for bodyweight squat to chair target.
cues: Hover above the chair instead of sitting down.
Keep your chest comfortably tall and your whole foot grounded.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Adds control and range while keeping a clear depth target.

exercises.name: Short-range glute bridge
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for short-range glute bridge.
cues: Press through your feet and lift only as high as feels comfortable.
Keep your ribs relaxed instead of arching your lower back.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Introduces hip extension with a deliberately small range.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for glute bridge.
cues: Press through your feet and lift your hips smoothly.
Finish with your body in a comfortable line from shoulders to knees.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Builds posterior-chain strength without standing balance demands.

exercises.name: Paused glute bridge
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for paused glute bridge.
cues: Pause briefly at the top while breathing normally.
Lower with control and reset before the next repetition.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Adds control to a familiar posterior-chain movement.

exercises.name: Reduced-range wall hinge
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for reduced-range wall hinge.
cues: Stand close to a wall and send your hips back gently.
Keep your spine long and stop at a comfortable range.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Teaches the hip-hinge pattern with a short target distance.

exercises.name: Wall hip-hinge drill
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for wall hip-hinge drill.
cues: Reach your hips back to touch the wall behind you.
Keep soft knees and feel the movement come from the hips.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Makes the hip-hinge direction easy to understand.

exercises.name: Unsupported bodyweight hinge
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for unsupported bodyweight hinge.
cues: Push your hips back without using the wall as a target.
Stand by squeezing your glutes rather than leaning backward.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Practises an independent hip hinge for daily lifting patterns.

exercises.name: More upright wall push-up
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for more upright wall push-up.
cues: Stand close enough to the wall that the movement feels easy.
Move your body as one line from head to heel.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Introduces pushing strength with a highly adjustable load.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for wall push-up.
cues: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Bend your elbows, bring your chest toward the wall, then press away.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Builds upper-body pushing strength without floor transitions.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for knee push-up.
cues: Set a straight line from your head through your knees.
Lower only as far as you can keep your trunk steady.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Increases pushing demand while retaining a shorter lever.

exercises.name: Standing wall W
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for standing wall w.
cues: Stand comfortably against a wall with your arms in a W shape.
Draw your shoulder blades gently down and together.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Introduces upper-back engagement in a supported position.

exercises.name: Prone W raise
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for prone w raise.
cues: Lie face down with your arms in a W shape.
Lift your hands slightly without shrugging your shoulders.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Builds awareness and endurance around the upper back.

exercises.name: Prone reverse snow angel
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for prone reverse snow angel.
cues: Sweep your arms slowly while keeping them just above the floor.
Use a pain-free range and keep your neck relaxed.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Adds controlled shoulder movement to upper-back endurance work.

exercises.name: Heel taps
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for heel taps.
cues: Keep your lower back comfortably heavy on the floor.
Tap one heel away and return before changing sides.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Introduces trunk control with one short moving lever.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for dead bug.
cues: Move the opposite arm and leg without arching your back.
Exhale as the limbs move away and return with control.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Builds trunk control while the arms and legs move.

exercises.name: Extended dead bug
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for extended dead bug.
cues: Reach the moving arm and leg farther only if your trunk stays steady.
Make the range smaller when your back begins to lift.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Progresses dead-bug control through a longer lever.

exercises.name: Single-limb bird-dog reach
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for single-limb bird-dog reach.
cues: From hands and knees, reach only one arm or one leg.
Keep your hips level and your movement slow.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Introduces quadruped trunk stability one limb at a time.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for bird dog.
cues: Reach the opposite arm and leg while keeping your hips square.
Return gently without shifting your weight quickly.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Challenges trunk stability with opposite-limb movement.

exercises.name: Paused bird dog
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for paused bird dog.
cues: Pause in the extended position while breathing normally.
Keep your ribs and pelvis facing the floor.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Adds control and time under tension to bird dog.

exercises.name: Supported march in place
exercises.terminalEasierModification: Use a smaller comfortable range and move more slowly.
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for supported march in place.
cues: Keep one hand near a stable chair and march at an easy pace.
Stay tall and place each foot down quietly.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Raises movement volume while keeping balance support nearby.

exercises.name: March in place
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for march in place.
cues: March at a pace that lets you speak in full sentences.
Land softly and let your arms swing naturally.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Adds accessible low-impact conditioning without equipment.

exercises.name: Low-impact step jack
exercises.illustrationAlt: Simple line illustration for low-impact step jack.
cues: Step one foot out as your arms rise, then return and change sides.
Keep the movement smooth and avoid jumping.
exercises.stopGuidance: Stop if you feel sharp pain, chest discomfort, faintness, or unusual shortness of breath.
exercises.educationalRationale: Adds whole-body rhythm and a modest conditioning challenge.
